Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EMSG3_DPTF_Debug_v1
Objects.description: EMSP G3 DPTF receiver debug (hardware in the loop)

variables.name: samples
variables.description: ADC samples fed to the receiver since reset

variables.name: packetsBad
variables.description: Detections above threshold where every candidate failed CRC

variables.name: hilMatched
variables.description: Decoded payloads matching a known HIL test payload

variables.name: hilMismatched
variables.description: Decoded payloads matching no known HIL test payload

variables.name: metricQ8
variables.description: Detection metric of the last attempt, 1/256ths

variables.name: marginQ8
variables.description: Worst per-symbol best/second slot ratio of the last packet, 1/256ths

variables.name: peakMag
variables.description: Largest chip magnitude in the captured stage

variables.name: magShift
variables.description: chipMag right shift: raw magnitude = chipMag << magShift

variables.name: candidate
variables.description: Which ranked candidate decoded the last packet (0 = best peak)

variables.name: chipPeriods
variables.description: Carrier periods per chip the firmware was built with

variables.name: expected
variables.description: HIL payload it was matched against

variables.name: slots
variables.description: Decoded PPM slot index per symbol

variables.name: chipMag
variables.description: Chip magnitude envelope of one stage: 8 guard, 18 preamble (6 ruler marks), 128 payload
